47942:129510.name: title/sml
47942:129510.description:
Title Small is the smallest title. 

Titles are smaller than Displays. They are typically reserved for medium-emphasis text that is shorter in length and not recommended for interactive components, rather page headings or sub headings.

47942:129515.name: body/med
47942:129515.description:
Body Medium is second largest body. 

Body texts are typically used for long-form writing as it works well for small text sizes. For longer sections of text, a serif or sans serif typeface is recommended.
